name: yovana-yoga
description: Yovana Yoga monorepo: Express API (backend) and Next.js website + admin (frontend)

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run start --prefix backend" "npm run start --prefix frontend"
